Journalist Ravi Nair Denied Bail in Adani Defamation Case

The Gujarat High Court has refused to release journalist Ravi Nair from custody in a defamation case filed by the Adani Group. Nair has been imprisoned in connection with this case. Concerns have been raised regarding his continued detention.
